reason: Oct/Nov 2006 Paper 5 mark scheme is a Qn / G / Expected Answers / Marks / Additional Guidance table whose Qn column prints the full part labels '1 a', '1 b', '1 c', '2 a', '2 b i', '2 b ii', '2 b iii', '2 b iv'. The splitter only recognised the bare '1' and '2' of the '1 c' and '2 b iv' lines, so 1(a), 1(b), 2(a) and 2(b)(i)-(iii) had no cut. The automatic Q1/Q2 keys are dropped and every part is cut by hand on the blank rows between the printed labels (p2), each printed Qn label whited out. The column-header row (p2 y75-85), the two 'Total 15' lines and the 'Paper 30' line are not marking points and are whited out (the gate does not recognise 'Qn ... Expected Answers' as a header row).
